mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_tool_configs WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM project_tool_configs WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE project_tool_configs SET name=#{name},connector_type=#{connectorType},endpoint=#{endpoint},auth_type=#{authType},credential_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{credentialCiphertext},credential_ciphertext),config=CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),enabled=#{enabled},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_tool_configs WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
